messages:
Nina T.: quick note: strict fncall validator v2.0 canary showing ~3% validation_failed -> routed to fallback_small and were doubling token counts.
Omar G.: example?
Nina T.: `tool_response: \"{\"result\": \"[]\"}\"` expected object not string.
Lena V.: product hates hidden retries. propose: emit header `X-Validation-Outcome` with values [ok, soft-warning, hard-fail, routed] and make billing ignore retries tagged soft-warning.
Omar G.: billing needs contract + backfill. I can schedule sync. also add metric `validation.v2.reject_rate` and reason dimension (type_mismatch, missing_field, malformed_json).
Nina T.: console: show a small warning badge and a link to sampled raw payload (scrubbed). add admin toggle: "Treat validation failures as warnings".
Lena V.: rollout: 1) metrics only, 2) badge + samples, 3) soft-warning for 1% traffic, 4) 10% after 48h, 5) enable billing rule after sign-off.
deploy-bot: Canary started for validator v2.0 on eng-platform (slice: beta). :rocket:
Nina T.: alert if reject_rate > 2.5% during canary; auto-pause at 4%.
deploy-bot: Canary paused (validation.v2.reject_rate = 4.1%). ref: alert#val-1024.
Omar G.: rolling back and opening RFC for header + sampling schema.
Lena V.: adding owners: Nina (validator), Omar (telemetry), Billing team.
Nina T.: will follow up with PR link and invites. thanks!
